summary: Enhance your skills with our International Project Management Training Course. Learn best practices and strategies to manage global projects effectively.
lede: International project management covers planning and delivering work across time zones, cultures and differing regulatory environments. It is for professionals planning, delivering or overseeing cross-border projects, and develops practical skills in assessing global risks, structuring multi-region schedules and coordinating distributed teams through asynchronous communication.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is structured for professionals who are responsible for planning, executing, or overseeing projects that span multiple countries, cultures, or regulatory environments.
modules: Global Project Control and Performance Measurement
Stakeholder Integration and Global PMO Strategy
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic project management principles, including scope definition and scheduling. No advanced technical or coding skills are required. We recommend bringing a current or upcoming international project scenario to apply during the workshop exercises.
